decisions.decision: Use m365:// as canonical resource scheme with mcp:// compatibility aliases.
decisions.rationale: Phase 08 Plan 08-10 made m365:// the primary durable resource namespace while preserving older clients and subscriptions that still use mcp://.

decisions.decision: Deliver prompts/list_changed only to matching discovery sessions.
decisions.rationale: Prompt list updates matter for editable skill surfaces and should not reach static or cross-tenant sessions.

decisions.decision: Publish resource update events with source/reason/changeType metadata and coalesce by tenant/session/uri/changeType.
decisions.rationale: Clients need useful update signals without cross-tenant leakage or notification storms.

decisions.decision: Map Graph webhook mail-message changes to resource URIs only.
decisions.rationale: Mail message resource IDs provide a safe Graph-backed update family without logging subjects, file names, or bodies by default.

decisions.decision: Run local full tests through the batched npm test runner with CI-flaky quarantine when reproducing CI shape.
decisions.rationale: Unbatched Vitest imports exhausted local heap; package npm test now clears NODE_OPTIONS and runs batches with default batch size 2 and heap cap.
